title: IRC: small irssi findings (329 per member, 330 shows nick, INVITE by unseen nick)
description: Found driving irssi 1.4.3 (2026-11-21): (1) 329 channel creation time differs per member (taken from each member's local room record key), so alice and bob see different 'created' times for one room; (2) WHOIS 330 gives the nick as the account name; the user URI would be more useful; (3) INVITE <nick> for a user this agent has never seen gets 401: only INVITE <user URI> works (the service help says so).
